paper_citation: G. Cacciamani, P. Riani, F. Valenza, Equilibrium between MB2 (M=Ti,Zr,Hf) UHTC and Ni: A thermodynamic database for the B–Hf–Ni–Ti–Zr system, Calphad 35, 601-619 (2011).
quote: Two invariant equilibria involving liquid are present: Liquid + (Ti, Zr)B2 TiB + bcc-(Hf, Zr) calculated at 1424 °C, in reasonable agreement with the experimental temperature of 1450 °C, and Liquid + (Ti, Zr)B2 ZrB12 + B calculated at 2022 °C in excellent agreement with the experimental value of 2020 °C.
